title: EvaluationReport
description: Contract 9: standardized, backend-comparable retrieval and answer metrics over a query set. Every number is measured: retrieval metrics come from the retrieved entities vs. the gold references, judge verdicts from a real LLM-as-judge call, and BERTScore only when the optional dependency is installed. Metrics that could not run are null (with a note) — never defaulted.

protocol.description: The protocol version identifier. Must be 'graphrag/1.0'.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of report generation.

backend.description: Backend the report was measured against (e.g. 'tigergraph').

model.description: Answer model used, or null when answers were extractive (no LLM configured).

avg_precision_at_k.description: Mean precision@k across queries; null when no query produced a measurement.

avg_recall_at_k.description: Mean recall@k across queries; null when no query produced a measurement.

judge_pass_rate.description: Share of judged answers that PASSed; null when no judge ran (no API key).

avg_bertscore_f1.description: Mean BERTScore F1 when the optional bert-score package is available; otherwise null.

notes.description: Explicit reasons for anything that could not be measured.

RetrievalEval.description: Per-query retrieval quality against a reference answer.

precision_at_k.description: Fraction of top-K entities matching the reference.

recall_at_k.description: Fraction of reference terms covered by retrieved entities.

AnswerEval.description: Per-query answer quality: LLM-as-judge plus optional BERTScore and a lexical grounding verdict.

judge_pass.description: LLM-as-judge verdict; null when no judge ran.

bertscore_f1.description: BERTScore F1 vs reference; null when unavailable.

faithfulness.description: 'grounded' | 'ungrounded' — whether the answer is backed by retrieved evidence.
